description: The /admin area: admin-only JSON APIs (users, contact, tickets) guarded by requireAdmin, a server-guarded /admin page that reuses the DashboardShell rail+topbar, a tabbed AdminView (Users/Contact/Tickets, driven by an extensible TABS config) with a clean read-only UI reusing existing design tokens and the planBadge helper, a calm empty state for Tickets, and an admin-only entry pinned in the rail-foot (bottom) of both DashboardShell and the editor LeftRail, gated on the server-provided isAdmin flag. Depends on FEAT-002 (requireAdmin, is_admin, tickets table, /api/auth/me isAdmin).
steps: APIs: Create web/src/pages/api/admin/users.ts, web/src/pages/api/admin/contact.ts, web/src/pages/api/admin/tickets.ts. Each: `export const prerender = false;` and a GET APIRoute that calls `const admin = await requireAdmin(ctx); if (!admin) return json(403,{error:{code:'FORBIDDEN',message:'Admins only.'}});` then runs the read and returns 200 JSON. Use a small `json(status,data)` helper like other routes.

APIs (users): Query users joined to plan/usage tables on the PREFIXED owner_id: `SELECT u.id, u.email, u.name, u.verified, u.is_admin, (k.owner_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_key, COALESCE(c.credits,0) AS credits, c.pro_until, COALESCE(t.ai_calls,0) AS total_ai, COALESCE(t.exports_used,0) AS total_exports FROM users u LEFT JOIN api_keys k ON k.owner_id = 'user:'||u.id LEFT JOIN credit_balance c ON c.owner_id = 'user:'||u.id LEFT JOIN usage_totals t ON t.owner_id = 'user:'||u.id ORDER BY u.created_at DESC LIMIT 1000`. Return rows with a computed `isPro` = (pro_until is not null AND pro_until > now) so the client can call planBadge({hasOwnKey:has_key, isPro, credits}) directly. Shape: { users: [...] }. Do not log row contents.
APIs (contact): `SELECT id, name, email, message, created_at FROM contact_messages ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 500` -> { messages: rows }.
APIs (tickets): `SELECT id, owner_id, email, subject, body, status, created_at FROM tickets ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 500` -> { tickets: rows }.

PAGE: Create web/src/pages/admin.astro mirroring web/src/pages/usage.astro: `export const prerender = false;`, import requireAdmin from '@/lib/auth', `if (!(await requireAdmin(Astro))) return Astro.redirect('/', 302);`, render `<AdminPage client:load />` inside the Dashboard layout with title 'Admin — Aptora' and path '/admin'.
PAGE ISLAND: Create web/src/components/pages/AdminPage.tsx mirroring UsagePage.tsx: `return <DashboardShell active="admin"><AdminView /></DashboardShell>;`.

SHELL: In web/src/components/pages/DashboardShell.tsx add 'admin' to the DashPage type and a TITLES['admin']='Admin' entry. DashboardShell has no live auth today: add a small useEffect that fetches /api/auth/me and stores an `isAdmin` boolean; when true, render an `<a href="/admin" class={viewCls('admin')} aria-label="Admin" data-label="Admin">` with a lucide-motion Shield/ShieldCheck icon INSIDE the existing `rail-foot` div (next to the Settings button, pinned bottom).

RAIL: In web/src/components/workspace/LeftRail.tsx extend the existing /api/auth/me fetch to also capture `isAdmin` (store in state); when true, render the same admin `<a href="/admin" class="rail-item">` with the Shield icon inside the existing `rail-foot` div (next to Settings).

VIEW: Create web/src/components/pages/AdminView.tsx. Define a `const TABS = [{key:'users',label:'Users',Icon:Users},{key:'contact',label:'Contact',Icon:Mail},{key:'tickets',label:'Tickets',Icon:Ticket}] as const;` (extensible array, not hardcoded one-offs; lucide-motion icons). useState for active tab key; a tab strip reusing existing dashboard CSS classes/tokens (follow UsageView.tsx styling conventions). Fetch the active tab's API on tab change. Users tab: a table/list of email, name, verified, is_admin, a plan chip via planBadge({hasOwnKey:row.has_key, isPro:row.isPro, credits:row.credits}) (import from '@/lib/utils'), credits, total_ai, total_exports; include a simple client-side text input filtering rows by email/name. Contact tab: list newest-first (name, email, message, created_at). Tickets tab: list newest-first with a calm empty state (e.g. 'No tickets yet.') when the array is empty — never fake rows (project rule 33). Read-only; no destructive actions.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run check` and `npm run build` (cwd web/) pass with no new errors.

GET /api/admin/users|contact|tickets return 403 {error:{code:'FORBIDDEN'}} for a guest or a verified non-admin, and 200 data for an admin; the users query joins plan/usage tables on 'user:'||u.id (prefixed owner_id).
/admin 302-redirects a non-admin/guest to '/' and renders the tabbed admin UI for an admin, reusing DashboardShell (shared rail + topbar).

AdminView renders Users/Contact/Tickets from an extensible TABS config; Users shows a planBadge chip + credits + lifetime usage and supports client-side search; Tickets shows a calm empty state when there are none.
An Admin entry appears in the rail-foot (bottom) of both DashboardShell and the editor LeftRail, and renders ONLY when /api/auth/me reports isAdmin:true.
verification: From d:\Enally.in\JD-Resume\web run `npm run check` and `npm run build`; confirm both pass.
Reason through the API routes: each GET returns 403 before any query when requireAdmin is null; the users SELECT uses 'user:'||u.id joins so plan/credits/usage map to the right owner.
Confirm the admin rail entry is gated on the server isAdmin flag (not a client assumption) in both DashboardShell and LeftRail.
findings: Implemented all 9 steps. APIs: web/src/pages/api/admin/{users,contact,tickets}.ts each prerender=false with a GET that calls requireAdmin(ctx) and returns 403 {error:{code:'FORBIDDEN'}} BEFORE any DB query. users.ts joins api_keys/credit_balance/usage_totals on the PREFIXED owner_id ('user:'||u.id), returns ONLY has_key (boolean) — no key material or password_hash — and computes isPro = (pro_until != null && pro_until > now) in JS so the client can call planBadge({hasOwnKey:has_key,isPro,credits}) directly. contact -> {messages}, tickets -> {tickets}. PAGE: admin.astro mirrors usage.astro, server-guards with `if (!(await requireAdmin(Astro))) return Astro.redirect('/',302)`, renders <AdminPage client:load/> in Dashboard layout (title 'Admin — Aptora', path '/admin'). ISLAND: AdminPage.tsx wraps <AdminView/> in <DashboardShell active='admin'>. SHELL: DashboardShell added 'admin' to DashPage, TITLES['admin']='Admin', a useEffect fetching /api/auth/me and rendering a ShieldCheck <a href='/admin'> in rail-foot ONLY when d.user.isAdmin is true. RAIL: LeftRail.tsx extended its existing /api/auth/me fetch to also set isAdmin and render the same ShieldCheck admin link in rail-foot gated on isAdmin (re-read fresh per ORCHESTRATOR-NOTES; v0.2.0 winbar edits untouched). VIEW: AdminView.tsx uses an extensible TABS=[{users,Users},{contact,Mail},{tickets,Ticket}] config (lucide-motion icons), a shared useTabData hook that lazily fetches each tab's API on activation, a Users table (email/name/verified/role + planBadge u3-pill chip + credits/AI/exports) with client-side email/name search, Contact and Tickets card lists newest-first, and a calm empty state for Tickets ('No tickets yet.') — read-only, no destructive actions (rule 33). Admin table/tab/card styles appended to dashboard.css reusing existing tokens + act-shimmer. Did NOT touch server/ or web/public/sw.js. Verification (cwd web/): `npm run check` = 0 errors/0 warnings/20 hints (hints all pre-existing unused-imports in untouched files; the one in my AdminView was removed). `npm run build` succeeded (exit 0), AdminPage bundled at dist/client/_astro/AdminPage.*.js; the CSS-minify text-overflow warning is pre-existing (.popover-user-email/.winbar-title), not from this feature.
